speaker: Amit Shah
quote_english: We will also make every effort to achieve 'One Nation, One Election'. This should also be discussed. ... Our resolution is for five years. We will bring it during this period.
summary: The Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2024 to enable simultaneous Lok Sabha and Assembly elections was introduced in December 2024 and sent to a Joint Parliamentary Committee, which as of July 2026 had not yet submitted its report.

analysis:
Shah said in a PTI interview published on 26 May 2024 that if the BJP formed the government it would work to implement 'One Nation, One Election' within its five-year term and would bring a bill during that period.

The Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2024 was introduced in the Lok Sabha on 17 December 2024 and referred to a Joint Parliamentary Committee. Through 2025 and 2026 the JPC continued nationwide consultations; its report deadline was extended to the Winter Session of 2026, and the committee chairman indicated that simultaneous elections are unlikely before 2034.

No simultaneous Lok Sabha and Assembly elections had been held by October 2026, so the target remains unrealised while the legislative process continues.
